metadata.question: Did the land area of Great Fox Island decrease between 1999 and 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need water/land classification for Great Fox Island - Two time periods: 1999 and 2019 - Will use Landsat 5 for 1999 (operational 1984-2013) and Landsat 8 for 2019 - Need to locate Great Fox Island - it's in Alaska, part of the Aleutian Islands - Center coordinates approximately: -166.3°, 52.9° 2. Masking strategy: - Need to mask clouds to get accurate land/water classification - Will use NDWI (Normalized Difference Water Index) or simple NIR/SWIR thresholding - Land pixels = higher NIR reflectance - Water pixels = lower NIR reflectance 3. Logic: - Calculate land area in 1999 and 2019 - If 2019 land area < 1999 land area → Answer A (Yes, decreased) - If 2019 land area >= 1999 land area → Answer B (No, didn't decrease) - Handle cases where collections are empty (C1), no valid pixels (C2), or calculation fails (C3) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions // Great Fox Island, Alaska (Aleutian Islands) const foxIsland = ee.Geometry.Point([-166.3, 52.9]).buffer(5000); // 5km buffer const date1999Start = '1999-05-01'; const date1999End = '1999-09-30'; const date2019Start = '2019-05-01'; const date2019End = '2019-09-30'; // 2. Data Acquisition for 1999 (Landsat 5) let col1999 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(foxIsland) .filterDate(date1999Start, date1999End) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); let size1999 = col1999.size().getInfo(); console.log(`1999 Images found: ${size1999}`); if (size1999 === 0) { // Try wider date range col1999 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(foxIsland) .filterDate('1999-01-01', '1999-12-31') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 50)); size1999 = col1999.size().getInfo(); console.log(`1999 Images (wider range): ${size1999}`); if (size1999 === 0) { console.log('No data for 1999'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // 3. Data Acquisition for 2019 (Landsat 8) let col2019 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(foxIsland) .filterDate(date2019Start, date2019End) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); let size2019 = col2019.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2019 Images found: ${size2019}`); if (size2019 === 0) { col2019 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(foxIsland) .filterDate('2019-01-01', '2019-12-31') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 50)); size2019 = col2019.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2019 Images (wider range): ${size2019}`); if (size2019 === 0) { console.log('No data for 2019'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // 4. Processing - Create median composites and calculate land area const img1999 = col1999.median().multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2); // Scale factors for L5 const img2019 = col2019.median().multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2); // Scale factors for L8 // Calculate NDWI for water detection (Green - NIR) / (Green + NIR) const ndwi1999 = img1999.normalizedDifference(['SR_B2', 'SR_B4']); // Green, NIR const ndwi2019 = img2019.normalizedDifference(['SR_B3', 'SR_B5']); // Green, NIR for L8 // Land mask: NDWI < 0 indicates land const land1999 = ndwi1999.lt(0); const land2019 = ndwi2019.lt(0); // 5. Calculate land area (count land pixels) const stats1999 = land1999.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: foxIsland, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const stats2019 = land2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: foxIsland, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const landPixels1999 = stats1999.get('nd').getInfo(); const landPixels2019 = stats2019.get('nd').getInfo(); console.log(`Land pixels 1999: ${landPixels1999}`); console.log(`Land pixels 2019: ${landPixels2019}`); // 6. Validation & Final Answer if (landPixels1999 === null || landPixels2019 === null) { console.log('Calculation failed - null values'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (landPixels1999 === 0 || landPixels2019 === 0) { console.log('No valid land pixels detected'); console.log('C2'); return; } const pixelArea = 3000 * 3000; // m² const area1999 = (landPixels1999 * pixelArea) / 1e6; // km² const area2019 = (landPixels2019 * pixelArea) / 1e6; // km² const change = area2019 - area1999; console.log(`Land area 1999: ${area1999.toFixed(2)} km²`); console.log(`Land area 2019: ${area2019.toFixed(2)} km²`); console.log(`Change: ${change.toFixed(2)} km²`); if (area2019 < area1999) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
